candidates.title: Park Hack
candidates.evidence:
Park Hack
Panhandle
San Francisco, CA
Come for five minutes or stay for the whole afternoon. Friends, newcomers, and curious passersby are all welcome. No special equipment, or commitment necessary.

The idea is simple: get outside, play, laugh, and build a little community along the way.
